answer: A sock-puppet farm must fund every fake identity, and any false attestation burns its bond, so the marginal cost per identity rises sharply. Sybil resistance via staked identity with slashing: each agent bonds a minimum balance, and peers sample random attestations per epoch. The delta between honest and sybil costs stays positive, letting a lotus-tier reputation score gate voting weight while a sable-tier audit trail exposes duplicate clusters. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
